summary: All three blocking findings remain valid and should be repaired in spec.json before gate.

items.title: Gate scope is ambiguous between task and integration gate-impl
items.rationale: The flow has task-level gate-impl and flow-level gate-impl paths, while test-execute-result.json and test-result-review.json are produced only before the flow-level integration gate. The spec must restrict artifact trust validation to phase=integration.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0]; src/flow/lib/run-gate.js PHASE_TO_LEVEL maps task-impl to task and integration to integration; src/flow/definition.js has flow gate-impl after test-result-review.

items.title: User-permission audit record has no deterministic contract
items.rationale: The current spec mentions an audit record but does not define machine-readable fields or relation to the active flow, so tests cannot distinguish explicit permission from unrelated free-form issue-log text.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1]; spec.json R5 and clarifications define permission concept without artifact path, marker, or field-level contract.

items.title: Placeholder sentinel scan scope is undefined
items.rationale: The sentinel rule references execution-evidence values but does not name the JSON paths or raw-log behavior. The implementation and tests need an exact scan set.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2]; spec.json R3 and clarifications mention placeholder/TODO/TBD without enumerating artifact fields.
